Game Overview

In Telepix, the core idea is straightforward: enter the mesmerizing pixel world of Telepix, where teleportation and timing are key to conquering 20 beautifully challenging levels. Navigate a landscape filled with cunning puzzles, engaging your reflexes and strategic thinking. Will you master the art of precision jumps and teleports to triumph?
